# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Category

Select one or more:

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Blender compatibility update
- [ ] AI workflow/update
- [ ] CI/automation
- [ ] Other

## Related issue

Link issue or write `not specified`.

## Files changed

List the main files changed and the purpose of each change.

## Tests

Describe what was tested.

Examples:

- Python syntax/compile check.
- JSON parse validation.
- Blender runtime test.
- Manual documentation review.

## Blender version

Specify Blender version tested, or write `not specified`.

## AI-generated or AI-assisted changes

- [ ] `AGENTS.md` was followed.
- [ ] `docs/AI_REPOSITORY_MANIFEST.md` was considered.
- [ ] `docs/QUALITY_GATE.md` was considered.
- [ ] `docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md` was considered.
- [ ] Target files were inspected before editing.
- [ ] Unverified assumptions are marked as `not specified`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and reviewable.
- [ ] No required generated data was deleted.
- [ ] Paths are configurable where practical.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated when the change is notable.
- [ ] Risks and untested areas are documented.
- [ ] Script line counts are reported for created or modified scripts.

## Notes

Add assumptions, risks, or follow-up work.
